policy: Committed fixtures must be synthetic, public, or explicitly licensed. No real user secrets, private health or business data, donor credentials, or production dumps. Every fixture carries provenance and regeneration instructions.

requirements.provenance_header: Each fixture directory must document source, license, creation date, and generator or acquisition method.
requirements.regeneration: Generated fixtures must record the exact generator script and seed so they can be reproduced.
requirements.no_secrets: Fixtures must pass scripts/scan-secrets.mjs and must not contain credential-like material.
requirements.size_budget: Fixtures stay small and bounded; large corpora live outside the repository and are referenced, not committed.

allowlisted_paths.rationale: Intentional synthetic scanner-validation strings (sk-abcdefgh..., BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY header) with no real credential value. Required to prove the secret scanner detects credential-like material.
